sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Vanguard Tactics (increases all stats by 150%, nullifies buff removal effects, applies Vital Strike (5% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%), applies Daredevil (fills Unison gauge by 30 when an enemy player is defeated)) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).

[Aqours] You Watanabe or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
